fixes: Official add-on: Blender 5.1+ and Edit > Preferences > System > Allow Online Access
Drag the official install link in twice (1st adds repo)
Start the server in add-on prefs; enable Auto Start
Only one Blender MCP add-on enabled (most use port 9876)
Fully quit Claude Desktop (not just close window), then reopen
claude.ai web cannot connect; use Claude Desktop or Claude Code
`uvx blender-mcp` = community server; official needs uvx --from git+https://projects.blender.org/lab/blender_mcp.git#subdirectory=mcp blender-mcp
Install uv with its official installer, not pip; clear cache: uv cache clean blender-mcp && uvx --refresh blender-mcp
Work on copies: every server can run arbitrary Python
